prompt: On a snowy mountain slope, a ski resort is alive with winter gear and activity. Seven skiers in colorful jackets glide past six wooden ski racks holding skis and snowboards. A cluster of snow-covered pines stands beside a stone chalet with five lit windows. A steaming mug of cocoa rests on a picnic table beside a plate of sugar-dusted cookies and a woolen scarf draped over a bench. Two snowmobiles idle next to a metal ski lift support, and a trail marker sign points toward the summit. Nearby, a snowman with a carrot nose and coal eyes stands beside a pile of firewood. There is no palm tree, no beach ball, no surfboard, no tropical drink, and no sand bucket.
